real_defects.issue: A directory passed stat() as an existing export target, so a '.' target naming a folder exited 0 though Node 22 refuses it (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT). Fixed: a directory reads missing; real-filesystem test added.

A folder-mapping key ('./lib/': './lib/', removed in Node 17) was classified literal: the CLI passed it (folder exists) and the page called it a missing file, while every import through it fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED (checked on node v22.23.5). Fixed: reported invalid with the './lib/*' replacement.

checkWildcards counted a file as reached when the * part held a node_modules/./.. segment, which Node refuses (ERR_INVALID_MODULE_SPECIFIER, checked on node v22.23.5); matters on the page, where a pasted listing can include bundled node_modules. Fixed with a test.
